## Add to Oikos Registry / Aggiunta all'Oikos Registry

> If this PR is NOT a registry submission, delete this template and describe your change freely.
> Se questa PR NON è un'aggiunta al registry, cancella questo template e descrivi liberamente.

---

### Repo

`author/repo-name` — https://github.com/author/repo-name

### Card type / Tipo

- [ ] JAVA card → added to `registry/cards`
- [ ] HTML card → added to `registry/html-cards`
- [ ] JSON Smart Card → added to `registry/smart-cards`

### Checklist

- [ ] Repo is public on GitHub
- [ ] At least one GitHub Release with dist files published
- [ ] `manifest.json` (JAVA) or `repository.json` (Smart Card) present at root
- [ ] `sdkVersion` set correctly (`^1.1.0` or `^1.0.0`)
- [ ] Tested on a real Oikos dashboard (install + update flow)
- [ ] No fetches to undeclared external hosts
- [ ] No `auth.access_token` access
- [ ] No global CSS injection
- [ ] Line added in alphabetical order
- [ ] Preview image included (`preview.png`, 3:2, ≤ 200 KB)
